stories.title: Iran Proposes Seven-Day Plan to Reopen Strait of Hormuz Amid US Discussions
stories.summary: Iran has proposed a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, contingent on meeting certain conditions. The Iranian Foreign Minister stated that normal maritime traffic could resume if these conditions are satisfied. Meanwhile, a US official indicated that constructive discussions are ongoing through mediators, although President Trump has reportedly rejected the Iranian proposal.

stories.title: Trump Dismisses Iran's Proposal to Reopen Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week and resume nuclear negotiations. The proposal, submitted through Qatar, included a condition for lifting the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports. Trump stated, 'They made a proposal but I reject it,' indicating expectations of renewed military actions following the midterm elections.

This decision follows a recent court order that restored CNN's access to the White House after a previous ban. The move is seen as part of ongoing tensions between the Trump administration and the news network.

stories.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump-Backed Congressional Map in Missouri
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected a Missouri congressional map backed by Trump and Republicans for the third time, preventing its use in the upcoming midterm elections. This ruling halts a federal appeals court decision that aimed to revive the Republican-friendly map, which was intended to give the party an electoral advantage. The justices issued their decision without any noted dissents.

Police have ruled her death a homicide, stating that the scene was staged following a drug dispute. The exact cause of her death has not been disclosed.
